direction-survival-rules-20261005.json.method: Production 21 by 15 collision map, continuous movement at three tiles per second, ordinary fixed-resource scavenging and same-action demo/manual playthroughs. No granted supplies, teleports, time overrides or forced objective completion. Dedicated body boundary fixtures are limited to the explicit hydration threshold and forged-save assertions. Weather, finite supplies, real fuel conservation, three-second boil, depletion, dawn-only sticky completion and strict versioned ledger save validation are exercised.

direction-survival-controller-20261005.j.method: Exported production createSurvivalController factory, actual HTML selectors, actual DOM callbacks and animation frames with the real survival engine. Only DOM, renderer, browser storage and RAF boundaries are adapters. Ordinary moves/actions build a valid saved camp and complete the manual and demonstration journeys. Browser visuals, CSS, native fullscreen hardware and touch are separate acceptance checks.

direction-space-rules-20261005.json.method: Production inertial flight and automatic steering/thrust/braking. Ordinary demonstration and manually repeated port actions have no position teleports, free cargo sales, synthetic task rewards or awarded completion. Explicit user-requested rescue alone waits six seconds then transports the vessel to dawn with ledger-accounted fees/fuel. Dedicated fixtures are limited to exact docking and scanning boundary assertions.

direction-space-controller-20261005.json.method: Exported production createSpaceController factory with actual DOM callbacks and the real flight, commerce, courier, survey and save-validation engine. Only the asynchronous renderer boundary and browser DOM are adapters. Tests ordinary animation-time completion, once-per-frame physics, retained inertia, multi-pointer controls, continuous scan, genuine station actions, camera requests, fullscreen targeting, delayed readiness, WebGL failure/retry and context loss. Actual WebGL visuals, browser CSS and hardware touch are separate browser acceptance.

direction-stealth-rules-20261005.json.method: Fixed production scene and continuous physics. All three automatic plans plus the same exported actions in manual mode. No teleports, fake pickups, awarded wins, unlimited inventory or AI state shortcuts in playthroughs. Counterfactual middle/lower crossings without their interventions are caught. Small isolated fixtures only for focused LOS, collision and hearing assertions.

direction-stealth-controller-20261005.js.method: Actual production controller imported with the real stealth engine and renderer, using a minimal DOM and no-op Canvas adapter. Final bitmap paths are checked on load. Verifies callbacks, real movement and all three ordinary-frame demo endings, paused valid-model restore, key focus guards, independent pointers, fullscreen targeting and asset failure. Browser CSS, hardware touch, fullscreen permission and rendered visual acceptance are separate.

direction-dungeon-rules-20261005.json.method: Production dungeon simulation using normal excavation, room construction, recruiting, scheduling and possession inputs. Checks cover actual path-dependent operations, gold and trap-stock accounts, three assault waves, collisions, pauses and strict save restoration.

direction-dungeon-controller-20261005.js.method: Actual production controller imported against real dungeon engine/render through a minimal DOM and Canvas adapter, including genuine image-path dependencies and material pixel initialization. This verifies callbacks and simulation state, not browser CSS, hardware touch, fullscreen permissions, browser refresh or rendered appearance.

direction-freight-rules-20261005.json.method: Production simulation; ordinary building, line purchases, actual freight loading/travel/unloading, conservation of all three cargo types and balance-sheet checks. No synthetic delivery grants.

direction-freight-controller-20261005.js.method: Actual production module callbacks through minimal DOM/no-op Canvas adapter, including a restored module instance. Production bitmap drawing checked separately with Skia. Browser CSS, touch/fullscreen and real browser refresh remain separate.

direction-shift-rules-20261005.json.method: Production simulation and ordinary dispatch actions; no synthetic progress, health or arrival grants. Both scenarios complete normally.

direction-shift-controller-20261005.json.method: Actual production callbacks with a minimal DOM/no-op Canvas adapter, including reload payload. Drawing checked separately with production Skia. Browser CSS, platform pointer/fullscreen/touch and browser refresh acceptance remain separate.

direction-coop-controller-20261005.json.method: Actual production module callbacks through a minimal DOM/no-op Canvas adapter; rendering separately verified with Skia. Not browser CSS, real touch/fullscreen/download dialog or refresh acceptance.

direction-factory-rules-20261005.json.method: Actual production engine, ordinary placement, packet transport, firing, waves, win/loss and save restoration. No browser acceptance claim.

direction-controller-checks-20261005.jso.method: Actual production page module and callbacks with DOM/Canvas adapter. Not browser CSS, pointer platform, fullscreen or localStorage acceptance.

direction-park-rules-20261005.json.method: Production park simulation and ordinary placement, BFS, preferences, queues, services, daily accounting and restore. No browser claim.

direction-park-controller-20261005.json.method: Actual production page callbacks with minimal DOM/no-op Canvas adapter; image drawing separately verified in five production Skia frames. Not browser CSS, pointer platform, fullscreen, touch or refresh storage acceptance.

browser_evidence.method: Actual Codex In-app Browser UI actions with ordinary clock, movement, resources and native keys; DOM evaluation only for visible text, selections, styles and rectangles. No browser hidden-state inspection, storage injection, resource grants or time changes. Screenshots are captured viewport pixels; CSS viewport and capture dimensions are recorded separately.
